title: Count invariant under coordinate permutation
statement: Let $\\pi$ be a permutation of the $n$ coordinates, and let $x\\in\\{-1,1\\}^n$. The number of coordinates equal to $1$ in the vector whose $i$th coordinate is $x_{\\pi(i)}$ equals the number of coordinates equal to $1$ in $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a permutation of the coordinates in $\fin n$
$x$ is a sign vector of length $n$
